messages:
Becca: Quick sync 1: need to finalize Vanguard Systems case study + webinar flow. Key asks: quote approvals, short live demo, consent on reg, and lead routing to AE queue. Brief here: https://redwood.docs/vanguard-case-brief :page_facing_up:
Dmitri: I'll take interview scheduling. Who are the spokes? CTO + Head of Product?
Becca: CTO for architecture impact, Head of Product for outcomes. Demo: 4 mins after opening remarks. Also want a 30s promo cutdown.
Hannah: Draft pull quote: "Vanguard saw measurable cost and latency improvements after switching to Redwood Inference." Tag percent claims with [LEGAL].
Ibrahim: Legal guidance: avoid exact percentages unless Vanguard provides an explicit signed stat. Use softer language like "measurable" or "material". If they want transcript redactions or an NDA, add 3 business days.
Noah: For routing: I'll map registration webhook to SFDC campaign Vanguard-Q3 and assign leads to queue 'ae-vanguard' when source=webinar. Adding a hidden field consent=true so we only route opted-in leads.
Becca: Please add consent checkbox copy: "I agree to be contacted by Redwood and to recordings being used for marketing." Hannah, can you draft that copy on the reg page?
Hannah: Done. Also sent the pull quote to Vanguard for redline and asked for permission to include a percent if they can confirm by email.
webhook-bot: registration form updated, webhook test passed in staging -> SFDC campaign Vanguard-Q3.
Dmitri: Sent Doodle with three slots. Vanguard asked for transcript access before publish; they may request minor redactions. Tagging Legal.
Ibrahim: Noted. If Vanguard requests a one-way NDA for transcript access, we can do it but expect +48-72 hours on the timeline. I'll prioritize review.
Becca: TL;DR: interviews pending Doodle, Legal looped for quote and any NDA, reg form consent added, SFDC routing to ae-vanguard, embargo target Aug 2. Check-in EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
